scripts.test:allure: rm -rf allure-results allure-report && npx playwright test --workers=2 && cross-env ALLURE_SINGLE_FILE=true npx allure generate ./allure-results -o ./allure-report --clean && npx http-server ./allure-report -p 9333 -a 0.0.0.0
scripts.report:allure: rm -rf allure-report && cross-env ALLURE_SINGLE_FILE=true npx allure generate ./allure-results -o ./allure-report --clean && npx http-server ./allure-report -p 9333 -a 0.0.0.0 & npx open http://localhost:9333
